column1: # Two channels, both driven by the mapper's Lith1Texture1/Lith1Texture2
# entries (exact TextureCodes.Code strings - the column stores full text):
#   tile   - multiplier on the SVG pattern tile width. Grain size made
#            literal: a coarse-grained unit draws a visibly coarser motif,
#            a fine-grained one a tighter weave. ~x1.12 geometric steps;
#            the 1.38 ceiling keeps the sqrt-compensated ink density within
#            Patterns template only - the plain template has no tile.
#   nudge  - Qt darker()/lighter() factor on the polygon fill (100 = no
#            change, >100 darker, <100 lighter). A curated whitelist, not
#            laminated) lift the fill slightly, clast textures (brecciated/
#            porphyritic) deepen it slightly. +-4% - a whisper; the label
#            parenthetical still carries the full words. Works in BOTH
#            templates via the dd fillColor expression.
# validated against TextureCodes at inject time; a typo aborts the run.
